values: ❗ If you find that important test cases are missing, add as necessary to this test plan with a time estimate. ❗
Is the subject line rendering correctly with proper spelling, grammar, and emojis (if relevant)?
Is personalized content rendering correctly within the subject line?
Does the sender name match the copy doc?
Is the sender name spelled correctly?
Does the from address match the copy doc?
Does the reply-to email address match the copy doc?
Does the preview text match the copy doc?
Does all spelling, punctuation, and grammar look correct?
Is personalized content rendered correctly? (No |FIRSTNAME|'s anywhere)
Does conditional content within the email match the variation?
Are there grammatical, spelling, or punctuation errors throughout the email body?
Are there grammatical, spelling, or punctuation errors throughout the graphics?
Do all images have proper alt-tags that describe the image and match what is present in the copy doc?
Are all links sourced properly and going to the correct place?

Remove if not appliclabe - Are all personalized UTM params matching the variation/treatment you're in?
PGM will specify in the comments of that ticket if the UTMs differ between variations
Verify the overall visuals of the email, anything standing out as "off"?
Does the email hold up in dark mode?
Are any areas of copy/visuals hard to read/view when looking at dark mode?
Does the email signature at the bottom of the body match what is present in the copy doc?
Are all DKIM authentifications passing for this variation?
